title: DISTRACT: Degradation-Indexed Study of Textual Reference Across Competing Targets
abstract: arXiv:2610.28419v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language trackers (VLTs) accept descriptions intended to assist tracking, but accepting text does not establish that its content changes tracking decisions, particularly as visual evidence deteriorates. We introduce DISTRACT, a matched-intervention benchmark that holds video, target, and distractor fixed while crossing four text priors with four image degradations along a controlled severity axis. We evaluate five VLTs on four datasets using behavioral contrasts, layerwise representation probes, and activation patching. Molmo2 and JointNLT exhibit directed text use. Some effects contract under degradation, whereas others show no significant endpoint change after multiplicity correction. UVLTrack, MMTrack, and DUTrack respond only weakly to changes in text semantics, with no directed behavioral effect surviving FDR correction in the tested settings. translated_title: DISTRACT：面向竞争目标的退化索引式文本指涉研究
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言跟踪器（VLT）接受旨在辅助跟踪的文本描述，但接受文本并不能证明其内容会真正改变跟踪决策，尤其是在视觉证据不断退化的情况下。我们提出了DISTRACT，这是一个匹配干预基准：在保持视频、目标和干扰物不变的前提下，将四种文本先验与四种图像退化沿受控的严重程度轴进行交叉组合。我们利用行为对比、逐层表示探测和激活修补（activation patching）方法，在四个数据集上评估了五种VLT。结果显示，Molmo2和JointNLT表现出有方向性的文本利用行为；其中一些效应在退化条件下会减弱，而另一些效应在经过多重性校正后未显示显著的终点变化。UVLTrack、MMTrack和DUTrack对文本语义变化的响应较弱，在所测试的设置中，没有任何有方向性的行为效应能在FDR校正后保留。模型内部分析揭示，在接近决策的状态下，正确目标与冲突目标之间的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了DISTRACT匹配干预基准，通过固定视频、目标和干扰物并交叉文本先验与图像退化的方式，系统检验视觉-语言跟踪器是否真正利用文本内容做出跟踪决策，发现仅Molmo2和JointNLT表现出有方向性的文本利用，而其余模型对文本语义变化的响应微弱。
en_tdlr: DISTRACT is a matched-intervention benchmark that systematically tests whether vision-language trackers' decisions are actually driven by text content under visual degradation, revealing that only Molmo2 and JointNLT exhibit directed text use while UVLTrack, MMTrack, and DUTrack respond only weakly.
